sample_unit: LLM-generated clinic letters (4 LLMs x 6 procedures x 2 letters), plus clinician letters as benchmark

links.outcome: Readability grade level and PEMAT-P understandability of LLM vs clinician clinic letters
links.effect: LLM letters at seventh-eighth grade level; Flesch-Kincaid 6.850-8.517 vs clinician letters 10.6 ± 0.94; PEMAT-P 0.72-0.83 for LLMs vs 0.72 for human letters.
links.quote: All LLMs produced text at a seventh-eighth grade level; Flesch‑Kincaid 6.850-8.517, markedly simpler than human letters (10.6 ± 0.94).

screen.reason: Compares LLM-generated patient clinic letters to clinician-written letters across standardized readability, understandability, and clinical complication inclusion metrics, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
